description: Answer 'which flows are there?': every cloud flow in the environment with its state, owner and last change, so you can see what the agent's flow tools can call and what a solution import left switched off. Read-only. This is the inventory only. For one flow's contents use cs_get_flow; for its execution history use cs_list_flow_runs; for the cause of a failure use cs_explain_flow_run.

clientId.description: Entra app (client) id for MSAL. Defaults to CPS_CLIENT_ID, then the first-party VS Code id.

dataverseUrl.description: Dataverse URL; default: from the workspace or the environment

environmentId.description: Power Platform environment id (GUID). Defaults to workspace sync metadata or CPS_ENVIRONMENT_ID.

includeManaged.description: Default true; false lists only unmanaged flows

search.description: Only flows whose name contains this text

tenantId.description: Entra tenant id. Defaults to the workspace sync metadata, then CPS_TENANT_ID.

workspace.description: Path to (or inside) the agent workspace. Defaults to CPS_WORKSPACE or the current directory.

name: cs_list_flows
title: List cloud flows
